events.text: Jekyll theorizes Hyde is smaller and younger because his evil side was less exercised.
events.quote: Edward Hyde was so much smaller, slighter and younger than Henry Jekyll

events.text: Jekyll looks at Hyde in the glass and feels welcome rather than repugnance.
events.quote: when I looked upon that ugly idol in the glass, I was conscious of no repugnance, rather of a leap of welcome

events.text: Jekyll drinks the cup again and returns to the body of Henry Jekyll.
events.quote: I once more prepared and drank the cup, once more suffered the pangs of dissolution

events.text: Jekyll concludes the projected being was Edward Hyde, wholly evil.
events.quote: the thing that was projected was Edward Hyde

events.text: Jekyll furnishes a house in Soho where Hyde is later tracked by police.
events.quote: I took and furnished that house in Soho, to which Hyde was tracked by the police

events.text: Jekyll hires a silent, unscrupulous housekeeper for the Soho house.
events.quote: engaged as a housekeeper a creature whom I knew well to be silent and unscrupulous

events.text: Jekyll tells his servants that Mr. Hyde may freely use his square house.
events.quote: I announced to my servants that a Mr. Hyde (whom I described) was to have full liberty and power about my house in the square

events.text: Jekyll draws up the will allowing Hyde to inherit without pecuniary loss.
events.quote: I next drew up that will to which you so much objected

events.text: Jekyll describes Hyde's pleasures turning monstrous and his own vicarious depravity.
events.quote: in the hands of Edward Hyde, they soon began to turn toward the monstrous

events.text: Hyde's cruelty to a child angered a passer-by, the doctor, and the child's family.
events.quote: An act of cruelty to a child aroused against me the anger of a passer-by

events.text: Hyde pacified them by paying a cheque drawn in Henry Jekyll's name.
events.quote: Edward Hyde had to bring them to the door, and pay them in a cheque drawn in the name of Henry Jekyll

events.text: Jekyll opened a bank account in Hyde's name and forged a signature for him.
events.quote: opening an account at another bank in the name of Edward Hyde himself

events.text: Jekyll woke in his square-house bed but saw his hand was Hyde's.
events.quote: It was the hand of Edward Hyde
